comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
This looks like a pretty good all-purpose ship. While not as fast as a LSC or LTS, it's not slow either. Can be refit for good cargo (close to 900) for trading purposes, not to mention the Nanban Trade Preference on it... Also, if you're a high lvl adventurer (as in lvl 60sih) but low in maritime, this makes a for a good maritime ship too. More armor than a Vaisseau, 60 cannons and 92 crew stock.

The only draw back appears to be that it'd cost you more than your average non-astro ship to build...
